12.proof_scope: Retain all prior edges. Each literal fullneighbor set is accepted by actualcurrentdegree and actualclosedR4 covering every oldvertex. Neighbor rules include fullQline images, pin-deletion subsets plusanchors, foldedBaer13blocking sets, and foldedminimalRedei15blocking sets plusanchors; do not infer subsetcoverage without actualR4. SingleExtension induction gives globalD<=5; degree-specificD4Moore bounds giveexactD5. Last independentallsource order remains42377. FirstBaer42398 andfirstRedei42399 had separate fresh-edge-backed newroot checks. Later unchanged-rule steps use their actual complete current-base degree/R4 evidence.
